lines.en: My soft body wobbles.
I slip under a blade of grass.
I creep slowly and carefully.

lines.zh: 我的表面有一层薄薄的黏液。
lines.en: A thin film of slime coats me.

lines.zh: 从石缝里挤出来，软软的。
lines.en: Squeezing out of the rock crack, soft-bodied.
I follow the other hatchlings.
I stop and puff up once.

lines.zh: 我挪到一块暖和的地方。
lines.en: I shuffle to a warm spot.
I go around a pebble.

lines.zh: 我慢慢朝有光的地方挪。
lines.en: I inch toward the light.
I rest by a grass root.
I puff up slowly.
There are many sounds in the forest.

lines.zh: 我在看一片叶子的影子。
lines.en: I am watching a leaf's shadow.
There is a faint shine on me.
I shrink a little smaller.
I listen to the wind in the grass.
My body is still very small.
I am waiting for the day I evolve.
My body swells and settles.
I roll slowly to one side.
No footsteps under the grass roots.
You look enormous.
Are you going to step on me?
I look up and cannot quite see you.

lines.zh: 我要仰起全身才看到你。
lines.en: I have to tip my whole body up to see you.
I have never seen your like.
Could you carry me?
I heard you speak.

lines.zh: 你挡住的这片阴凉很好。
lines.en: The shade you cast feels good.
I ease back a little.

lines.zh: 泡泡兽刚孵化，什么都陌生。
lines.en: Just hatched, Bubbmon finds everything strange.
I puff up as a greeting.
Have you crouched down?

lines.zh: 我还没长出自己的样子。
lines.en: I have not grown into my own shape yet.
Would you take me in?
I roll several blocks away.
A small hole has opened in my membrane.
A tiny bit of my surface is broken.
I crawl slowly back into the grass.

lines.zh: 你踩得不重，可我还是疼。
lines.en: Your step was light, and it still hurt.
My bubbles didn't shield me. It hurts.
I'm still in my baby stage, and my shell is too soft.
Stop hitting me, I haven't even digivolved yet.
Is there something to eat?
Shifted two steps that way.
You set the feed down on the grass.
It smells like the inside of the egg.
I press against it and sip a little.
I cannot get a grip on this much feed.
Is there a little more?
I press myself against it.
This is nearly twice my size.
I puff myself up again.
You touched me lightly.
I roll a short way.
I am soft as a bubble.
I roll away from your foot.
Your sole is hard.
I bounce once, slowly.
Don't push; I will roll far.
I roll back beside the grass blades.
I am only a baby stage.
That is far beyond me.
I must grow first.
Your question confuses me.

lines.zh: 草地里有很多我的同类。
lines.en: There are many of my kind in the grass.
Ask after I digivolve.
I did not follow that.
I roll slowly away.
That subject is too big for me.
I press my whole body onto it.
Too big; I cannot carry it.
It stuck to me.
I slowly push it back.
I taste it; not good.
It rolled twice.
I leave it by the grass.
Good; I will keep it.
I puff up toward it.
I am wondering whether to go over.
My body has puffed up.
I am ready to blow a bubble.
It has come a little nearer.
I must retreat into the grass first.
I am afraid it will tread on me.
I edge back under a blade of grass.
I follow behind the blades of grass.
I hold still behind a grass stem.
I puff up to look bigger.
It has not even glanced at me.
I puff myself up and inch forward.

lines.zh: 我贴着石头底下溜过去。
lines.en: I slip along beneath the stone.
Its steps make me tremble.
It turned; I flatten.
I shrink and let it pass.
I follow it between the grass roots.
When it moves, the grass sways.
I blow a bubble.

lines.zh: 泡泡打在它身上，啪一声。
lines.en: The bubble hits it with a pop.
My bubble is soft.
I puff up and ram it.
It lifts a foot and I roll clear.
I blow another bubble.
The bubble bounces once before popping.

lines.zh: 它退了半步，不是因为疼。
lines.en: It stepped back, but not from pain.
I curl up and stay still.
It went; I slowly straighten.
It ignored me and walked on.
I hatch from a Digitama.
The first thing I see is grass.
My body is small and wet.

lines.zh: 这片林子里有很多同伴。
lines.en: There are many of my kind in this wood.
I puff up slowly.
There are other hatchlings in the distance.
The wind makes me wobble.
I start crawling into the grass.
This looks safe.
I hatched wet and soft all over.
Good; let me find something to eat.
The heat dries my body out.

lines.zh: 我从高处掉下，摔得扁了。
lines.en: I fall from a height and land flat.
Too much water; I cannot take it either.
The blast blows me into the air.
An arrow grazes me and splits a bit.

lines.zh: 那股力量让我全身发麻。
lines.en: That force numbs me all over.
Nothing eaten; I grow smaller.

lines.zh: 雷光一闪，我的黏液都亮了。
lines.en: The flash lights up my slime.
I fall, my body tumbling.
